subject: Edge proxy MTU/MSS and ephemeral port access — urgent connectivity escalation
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@deltacloud.com>

Cc: DeltaCloud NOC <noc@deltacloud.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 19:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent 502s & connection resets to private deployment behind your edge proxy

Hi Vanessa,

We're seeing intermittent 502/connection-reset errors from our customers hitting the private deployment you manage for our staging cluster. The problem started after we rolled a small FW change on our side yesterday evening, but traces indicate packets from the customer path are being MTU-fragmented between our firewall and Redwood's edge proxy which then resets. Attaching a short tcpdump and a trace.

Symptoms:
- Client TCP handshake completes, then POSTs produce RST from the proxy after ~1.2s
- PMTU discovery doesn't seem to be working (ICMP blackhole suspected)
- Some flows show SNAT egress ports outside the allowed ephemeral range which your SG may be blocking

We can make a quick config change on our firewall (enable MSS clamping to 1420) if that will help, but wanted to coordinate before making changes on production path. Can your team validate whether the edge proxy is stripping DF or performing any additional SNAT that could cause path MTU issues?

Attached: deltacloud-trace-20270321.txt, edge-debug-ports.pcap

Thanks — Alex

Subject: Re: Intermittent 502s & connection resets to private deployment behind your edge proxy

Alex/Vanessa — I pulled the pcap and trace. Quick findings:
- We observe SYN->SYN/ACK->ACK completing end-to-end, but the subsequent POST (large payload ~1.6KB segments) triggers RST from the proxy.
- The packets carry the DF bit; path MTU discovery is in use. We see ICMP 'Fragmentation needed' replies from the intermediate AF firewall that never seem to reach the client. That explains PMTU not converging.
- On our side, the edge proxy performs SNAT for private deployments to a pool for source-address preservation. The NAT implementation keeps ephemeral ports, but we have a known edge case where if the client's source port range uses low ephemeral ports (<32768) and your firewall rewrites ports, the SG on the backend can drop responses if the ephemeral range isn't permitted.

Actions I recommend now (low-risk):
1) Temporarily enable MSS clamping to 1400 on the DeltaCloud firewall for the flow to the proxy. That will prevent large segments that require fragmentation.
2) On our side, we'll enable explicit MSS clamp on the edge proxy (per-tenant) and open a wider ephemeral port acceptance between proxy and private nodes (32768-65535).
3) I'll run a targeted tcpdump on the proxy interface and a conntrack snapshot right before/after your change.

Command examples (edge proxy):
- sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1  # enable probing
- iptables -t mangle -A PREROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1400

Can DeltaCloud toggle MSS clamp for a 30-minute window tonight? If yes, please confirm ETA and I'll coordinate with Marissa to schedule traffic tests and rollback.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@deltacloud.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: DeltaCloud NOC <noc@deltacloud.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 21:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 502s & connection resets to private deployment behind your edge proxy

Thanks Rishi — we can enable MSS clamping in a 30-minute maintenance window at 23:00 PT tonight. Config snippet we tested in staging:

- set firewall mss-clamp tcp 1400
- allow icmp-frag-needed inbound from 10.0.0.0/8 to 52.23.0.0/16

We'll apply that and ping you here. If you can apply the proxy-side TCPMSS rule at the same time (or confirm you've already applied it for the tenant), we'll run the synthetic load and verify the POSTs. We'll also include a conntrack dump post-change.

Alex

Scheduling note: DeltaCloud will apply MSS clamp at 23:00 PT tonight (window 23:00-23:30). Rishi/Irene, I'll request the following from infra during that window:
- Apply iptables TCPMSS set-mss 1400 on proxy egress to the tenant pool
- Increase ephemeral acceptance range (32768-65535) on proxy-side SGs to avoid accidental drops
- Capture conntrack snapshot and tcpdump (10s pre-change, continuous for 5m post-change)

Rollback plan: if error rate increases or any internal health check fails, we will remove the mangle rule and revert SG changes immediately. Vanessa — I'll post updates in the shared incident doc (link below).

Subject: Re: Intermittent 502s & connection resets to private deployment behind your edge proxy

Post-change update: we applied MSS clamp 1400 at 23:04 PT and ran a synthetic load of large POSTs. Behavior improved immediately — no RSTs observed in a 15-minute run, and PMTU converged correctly. DeltaCloud NOC captured the following artifacts and uploaded to the shared folder: edge-debug-ports.pcap, deltacloud-trace-20270321.txt, conntrack-snap-after.txt.

Observations:
- Enabling MSS clamp on the firewall eliminated intermediate fragmentation and the proxy no longer sent RSTs.
- After Rishi's SG tweak, we saw fewer dropped replies and consistent source-port mapping into the allowed ephemeral range.

Thanks for the fast coordination. Please leave the proxy-side TCPMSS rule in place for 48h and we'll retest with production traffic ramp tomorrow. I'll close the ticket once we see two full business days of clean traffic.

Alex Rivera
Network Engineer, DeltaCloud
